Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Chairman ke exact powers

Budget, Committees, Privileges, Question Hour, Zero Hour

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumhare gaanv mein jab koi bada faisla lena hota hai - jaise naya school banana ho - to log kahan jaate hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Panchayat mein sir! Mukhiya aur sab log baithke decide karte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ab socho, poore Bihar ke liye faisla lena ho to Vidhan Sabha hai. Lekin poore INDIA ke liye - jaise sabka tax rate ek jaisa ho, sabke liye ek jaisa passport rule ho - us faisle ke liye Delhi mein ek bahut bada 'Panchayat' baithti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa... wahi jo Republic Day pe TV pe dikhta hai, wo bada gol building?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul wahi! Usko kehte hain 'Parliament' - poore desh ke liye kanoon banane wali sabse badi sansthan. Ab exam-language seekho: hamare Constitution ka Article 79 kehta hai ki 'Parliament' teen cheezon se milkar banti hai - President, Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, President bhi Parliament ka part hai?? Wo to alag office mein baithte hain na, Rashtrapati Bhavan mein!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahi sabse bada trap hai jo BPSC baar-baar poochti hai! President physically LS/RS mein baithkar bahas nahi karte, lekin unke bina koi bhi bill kanoon nahi banta - unki assent (sehmati) zaroori hai. Isliye Constitution unhe Parliament ka ANG (part) maanta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab bina President ke sign ke, koi bhi law valid nahi hoga? Ye to important point hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul, yaad rakho. Ab dekho, do Sadan (Houses) kyun hain? Lok Sabha ka matlab 'House of the People' - awaam seedhe vote karke apne MP chunti hai. Rajya Sabha ka matlab 'Council of States' - ye states ka pratinidhitva karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir Bihar ki Vidhan Sabha bhi to bas ek hi sadan hai na? Fir Parliament mein do kyun?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Achha observation! Jaha do sadan hote hain use 'Bicameral' kehte hain, jaha ek hi hota hai use 'Unicameral'. ⭐ BPSC TRE Favorite: Bihar Vidhan Sabha bhi actually Bicameral hai - Vidhan Sabha + Vidhan Parishad dono hain, jaise UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka mein bhi hai. Par har state mein Vidhan Parishad zaroori nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! To Parliament hamesha do sadan wali hi hoti hai, national level pe?

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Article 79 ke anusaar, Bharatiya Parliament kin-kin ka gathan hoti hai?

options.text: Sirf Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha
President, Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha
Prime Minister, Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 79 saaf kehta hai: Parliament = President + Lok Sabha + Rajya Sabha. President ki assent ke bina koi bhi bill Act nahi ban sakta, isliye wo Parliament ka avibhajya ang hain.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: 'Council of States' kis Sadan ka anya naam hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Rajya Sabha ko 'Council of States' kaha jaata hai kyunki ye states ke hiton ka pratinidhitva karti hai. Lok Sabha ko 'House of the People' kehte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Do Sadan wali vidhayika ko kya kehte hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Do sadan wali vidhayika 'Bicameral' kehlati hai (jaise Parliament of India), aur ek sadan wali 'Unicameral' (jaise Bihar Vidhan Sabha akele hoti to).

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Foundation strong ho gayi Raju! Ab asli building banayenge - Lok Sabha se!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab Lok Sabha detail se samjhte hain. Isko 'Lower House' bhi kehte hain, lekin power mein ye kam nahi, upar hi hai! Article 81 ismein composition define karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isme members kaise aate hain? Seedhe janta chunti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan bilkul - direct election, universal adult suffrage se. Matlab 18 saal ya usse zyada umar ka har bharatiya nagrik vote de sakta hai - ye 61st Amendment (1988) se hua, pehle voting age 21 thi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Pehle 21 saal thi to sirf badi umar walon ko hi vote milta tha. Ab to mere bade bhaiya 18 ke hain, wo bhi vote de sakte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab exam ka sabse bada confusion suno dhyan se - Lok Sabha ki maximum strength. Original Constitution ke hisaab se maximum 552 members ho sakte the - 530 states se, 20 Union Territories se, aur 2 Anglo-Indian community ke President dwara nominated.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 552? Par sir humne to news mein 543 suna hai hamesha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda! Abhi actual strength 543 hai kyunki delimitation ke baad seats freeze hain 1971 ki janasankhya par - 84th Amendment ne ye freeze 2026 tak badha diya hai, taki jo states population control kar rahe hain unko seat nuksan na ho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur wo 2 Anglo-Indian wali seat ka kya hua? Wo to 552 mein add hoti thi na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ruko, yahi sabse bada recent trap hai! 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019 ne Anglo-Indian community ke liye Lok Sabha aur Vidhan Sabhaon mein nomination ka provision khatam kar diya - ye 25 January 2020 se effective hua.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh ab maximum strength 552 nahi rahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi socha! Ab theoretical maximum strength 550 hai (530 states + 20 UT), Anglo-Indian ka provision hat gaya. Par actual current strength abhi bhi 543 hi hai - ye number BPSC/SSC dono mein poocha jaata hai, dono figures yaad rakhna: Max=550, Actual=543.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to exam me pakka confuse karega! 552, 550, 543 - teeno number yaad rakhne padenge!

guess_payload.question: Guess karo: Lok Sabha ka normal karyakaal (tenure) kitne saal ka hota hai, jab tak ise pehle bhang na kiya jaaye?
guess_payload.explanation: Article 83(2) ke anusaar Lok Sabha ka tenure 5 saal hai, uske baad automatically bhang ho jaati hai. Emergency ke dauran Parliament kanoon banakar ise 1 saal ke liye badha sakti hai, ek baar mein, jitni baar chahe (jab tak Emergency chalti rahe), lekin Emergency khatam hone ke 6 mahine baad se aage nahi badha sakti. ⭐ Bihar Vidhan Sabha ka bhi tenure 5 saal hi hota hai - same rule state level pe.

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019 ke baad Lok Sabha ki theoretical maximum strength kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Anglo-Indian nomination provision (2 seats) khatam hone ke baad, theoretical maximum strength 552 se ghatkar 550 (530 states + 20 UTs) ho gayi. Actual current strength abhi bhi 543 hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Lok Sabha seats ka current delimitation (freeze) kis year ki janganana par based hai, aur kab tak freeze hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 42nd Amendment (1976) ne seats freeze ki thi 1971 janganana par, aur 84th Amendment (2001) ne isse 2026 tak badha diya - taki population control karne wale states ko political nuksan na ho.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Voting ka minimum umar kitna hai, aur ye kis Amendment se lagu hui?
quiz_payload.explanation: 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 ne Article 326 mein voting age 21 se ghatakar 18 saal ki - Rajiv Gandhi sarkar ke dauran.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Lok Sabha - The House of the People
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Lok Sabha ke saare numbers pakke ho gaye! Ab Rajya Sabha ki baari!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab Rajya Sabha - Upper House. Article 80 iski composition batata hai. Iski maximum strength 250 hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir 250 mein se sab elected hote hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju! Yahi twist hai - 238 members states aur UTs se elected hote hain (Fourth Schedule mein seat allocation di gayi hai), aur 12 members President dwara nominate kiye jaate hain - Article 80(3).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nominate kis basis pe hote hain? Koi bhi bana denge kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi, arbitrarily nahi. Constitution mein specific field diye hain - Literature, Science, Art aur Social Service mein special knowledge ya practical experience rakhne wale logon ko nominate kiya jaata hai. Jaise Sachin Tendulkar (sport), Lata Mangeshkar (art) nominate hue the.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Matlab Lok Sabha mein to koi nominated nahi hota, sab elected hote hain, par Rajya Sabha mein kuch nominated bhi hote hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda! Ab current numbers dekho - J&K Reorganisation ke baad current Rajya Sabha strength 245 hai (233 elected + 12 nominated). Ye 250 maximum se kam hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur Bihar se kitni seats hain sir Rajya Sabha mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ BPSC TRE Favorite: Bihar se Rajya Sabha mein 16 seats hain, aur Lok Sabha mein 40 seats hain - ye dono numbers BPSC bahut baar poochti hai, ratt lo!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Yaad kar liya sir - Bihar: 40 Lok Sabha, 16 Rajya Sabha! Par sir Rajya Sabha kabhi bhang kyun nahi hoti, Lok Sabha to hoti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut badhiya sawal! Rajya Sabha ek 'Permanent House' hai - kabhi dissolve nahi hoti. Har member ka tenure 6 saal ka hota hai, lekin har 2 saal mein 1/3rd members retire karte hain aur unki jagah naye members aate hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! Matlab jaise ek pipeline chal rahi ho - kabhi khaali nahi hoti, bas dheere dheere purane log jaate hain aur naye aate hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi analogy! Isi wajah se Rajya Sabha ko 'Permanent House' kehte hain, jabki Lok Sabha ko 5 saal baad ya beech mein bhi bhang kiya ja sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir election kaise hota hai Rajya Sabha ka? Janta seedhe vote nahi karti na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sahi pakda - Rajya Sabha members INDIRECTLY elected hote hain. State ki Vidhan Sabha ke elected members (MLAs) vote karte hain, wo bhi Proportional Representation by means of Single Transferable Vote system se - ye ek complex voting method hai jisse alag-alag party ke candidates jeet sakein.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab hum janta seedhe Rajya Sabha MP nahi chunte, MLA log chunte hain hamari taraf se!

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Rajya Sabha ki maximum strength kitni hai, aur usme kitne members nominated ho sakte hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 80: Rajya Sabha maximum 250 members - jisme 238 states/UTs se elected aur 12 President dwara nominated (Literature, Science, Art, Social Service ke experts) hote hain.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Rajya Sabha ke members kis tarah elect hote hain?

options.text: Direct election, janta seedhe vote karti hai
Indirect election - State Vidhan Sabha ke MLA vote karte hain (PR-STV system)
Lok Sabha ke members vote karte hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Rajya Sabha members ko States ki Vidhan Sabhaon ke elected members, Proportional Representation by Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) system se indirectly elect karte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Rajya Sabha ko 'Permanent House' kyun kaha jaata hai?

options.text: Kyunki ye kabhi bhang nahi hoti, sirf 1/3rd members har 2 saal mein retire hote hain
Kyunki iske members ka tenure life-long hota hai
Kyunki isme koi election nahi hota
Kyunki President ise kabhi prorogue nahi kar sakte

quiz_payload.explanation: Rajya Sabha ek continuing chamber hai jo kabhi poori tarah dissolve nahi hoti. Har member 6 saal ke liye chuna jaata hai, aur har 2 saal mein 1/3rd retire karke unki jagah naye members aate hain - isliye 'Permanent House'.

milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Do sadan pakke ho gaye! Ab dekhte hain member banne ki kya sharten hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho tumhare papa gaon ka Mukhiya banna chahte hain - to kuch minimum sharten to honi chahiye na, jaise umar aur nagrikta?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan sir, warna koi bhi khada ho jayega chunav mein!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi. Article 84 mein MP banne ki qualifications di gayi hain: (1) Bharat ka nagrik hona chahiye, (2) Lok Sabha ke liye minimum umar 25 saal, Rajya Sabha ke liye 30 saal, (3) Parliament dwara banaye gaye kanoon (Representation of People Act, 1951) ke hisaab se aur qualifications poori karni hongi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 25 aur 30 - alag alag kyun sir? Rajya Sabha mein zyada umar kyun chahiye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kyunki Rajya Sabha ko 'Council of Elders' bhi socha jaata hai - jyada anubhav aur pariparkvta (maturity) wale logon ka sadan. Isliye umar limit thodi zyada rakhi gayi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha samajh gaya! Aur agar koi member galat kaam kare, to usse nikala kaise jaata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut important sawal! Article 102 disqualifications batata hai. Agar koi member: office of profit rakhta ho, unsound mind ho (court dwara declared), undischarged insolvent ho, Bharat ka nagrik na ho ya kisi videshi desh ki nagrikta le li ho, ya kisi kanoon ke tehat disqualified ho - to wo member banne ke laayak nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Office of profit? Matlab agar wo sarkari naukri bhi kare to?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Office of profit ka concept hai ki agar MP koi aisi sarkari post pe hai jaha se salary/labh milta hai (jise kanoon ne exempt na kiya ho), to wo apna independent decision nahi le payega, sarkar ke dabaav mein aa sakta hai - isliye conflict of interest maana jaata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh kya har sarkari kaam karne wale ko disqualify kar denge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi, Parliament kanoon banakar kuch posts ko is rule se exempt kar sakti hai - jaise Minister ka pad khud office of profit mein nahi aata, use special exempt kiya gaya hai. Ye judgment case-by-case hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab Minister banna office of profit nahi maana jaata but koi aur sarkari commission ka chairman banna ho sakta hai!

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha ke sadasya banne ke liye minimum umar kramsah kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 84 ke anusaar: Lok Sabha ke liye minimum 25 saal, Rajya Sabha ke liye minimum 30 saal umar zaroori hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Article 102 ke tehat, niche mein se kaun MP banne ke liye disqualification ka aadhar NAHI hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Constitution mein educational qualification ki koi shart nahi hai MP banne ke liye. Disqualification ke aadhar hain: office of profit, unsound mind, undischarged insolvent, videshi nagrikta, aur kanoon ke tehat disqualification (jaise anti-defection).

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: MP ki qualifications ka detail kis kanoon mein aata hai jo Parliament ne khud banaya?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 84(c) ke tehat Parliament ko power di gayi hai ki wo kanoon banakar additional qualifications tay kare - ye kaam Representation of People Act, 1951 se hua hai.

milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Ab sabse zyada BPSC-favorite topic aata hai - Dal-badal kanoon! Taiyaar ho jao!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho tumhari cricket team mein tum ek team se khelne ka wada karke maidan mein utre, aur beech match mein doosri team ke liye khelne lag jao - kaisa lagega?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to dhokha hoga! Match hi kharab ho jayega!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Politics mein bhi aisa hota tha - MP/MLA ek party ke ticket pe jeetkar doosri party join kar lete the, sarkar giraane ke liye. Isko rokne ke liye 52nd Constitutional Amendment, 1985 laayi gayi - jisne 10th Schedule (Anti-Defection Law) Constitution mein add ki.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Isko 'Dal-badal Kanoon' kehte hain na sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi naam hai. Ab dhyan se suno - kis condition mein MP disqualify hota hai? Do main grounds hain: (1) Agar wo swayं (voluntarily) apni party ki membership chhod de, (2) Agar wo party whip ke against vote kare ya voting mein absent rahe bina permission ke.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir agar party khud tod di jaaye, matlab split ho jaaye, tab bhi disqualify honge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut badhiya trap-catching sawal! Pehle (1985 se 2003) 'split' ka provision tha - agar party ka 1/3rd group alag ho jaaye to disqualify nahi hote the. Lekin 91st Amendment, 2003 ne ye SPLIT provision hata diya!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh ab kya bacha hai? Party chodne ka koi rasta nahi bacha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ek exception abhi bhi hai - 'MERGER'. Agar original political party ke kam se kam 2/3rd members kisi doosri party mein MERGE hone ko raazi ho jaayein, to wo disqualify nahi honge. Ye 91st Amendment ne hi laaya tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur sir ye decide kaun karta hai ki disqualify karna hai ya nahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye faisla Presiding Officer karta hai - Lok Sabha mein Speaker, Rajya Sabha mein Chairman. Par 1992 ke famous Kihoto Hollohan case mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki Speaker ka ye faisla judicial review ke daayre mein aata hai - matlab Court usse challenge kar sakti hai agar mala fide ho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab Speaker final nahi hai, Court check kar sakti hai! Ye to bahut important point hai exam ke liye.

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Anti-Defection Law (10th Schedule) kis Constitutional Amendment se laayi gayi?
quiz_payload.explanation: 10th Schedule (Anti-Defection Law) ko 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985 dwara Constitution mein jodha gaya, Rajiv Gandhi sarkar ke dauran.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: 91st Constitutional Amendment, 2003 ne Anti-Defection Law mein kya BADLAV kiya?

options.text: 'Split' provision (1/3rd group) ko hata diya, ab sirf 2/3rd Merger hi valid exception hai
Anti-Defection Law ko poori tarah khatam kar diya
Speaker ki power ko badha diya
Rajya Sabha ke members ko is kanoon se bahar kar diya

quiz_payload.explanation: 91st Amendment, 2003 ne 'split' ka provision (jisme 1/3rd members alag hokar bhi disqualify nahi hote the) hata diya. Ab sirf 'merger' (2/3rd members ki sahmati se) hi valid exception bacha hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Kihoto Hollohan case (1992) mein Supreme Court ne kya nirnay diya?

options.text: Speaker ka defection ka faisla judicial review ke daayre mein aata hai
Speaker ka faisla kabhi challenge nahi ho sakta
President hi defection decide karenge, Speaker nahi

quiz_payload.explanation: Kihoto Hollohan vs Zachillhu (1992) mein SC ne kaha Speaker/Chairman ka faisla ek quasi-judicial function hai aur agar mala fide, perverse ya rules ke against ho to wo judicial review ke daayre mein aata hai.

milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Dal-badal kanoon ka boss ban gaye tum! Ab Sadan chalane wale officers ko jaano.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, class mein jab teacher nahi hoti, monitor line manage karta hai na? Sadan mein bhi ek 'monitor' hota hai jo poori bahas ko control karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wo Speaker hote hain na sir, jo TV pe 'Order Order' bolte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Speaker Lok Sabha ke presiding officer hote hain - Article 93 ke tehat, Lok Sabha khud apne members mein se ek ko Speaker aur ek ko Deputy Speaker chunti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Speaker ka pehla naam kya tha sir, India ka?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: India ke pehle Speaker the G.V. Mavalankar. Ab Speaker ki powers samjho: wo Sadan mein order maintain karte hain, decide karte hain ki koi bill Money Bill hai ya nahi (unka faisla FINAL hota hai, court mein challenge nahi ho sakta), aur normally vote nahi dete.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bilkul vote nahi dete? Fir agar tie ho jaaye vote mein to?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahi Article 100 ka important rule hai - Speaker sirf TIE hone par 'Casting Vote' dete hain, apni marzi se nahi. Normal voting mein wo hissa nahi lete, sirf jab barabar vote aayein tabhi apna decisive vote dete hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab Speaker ek referee ki tarah hai, jo sirf tie-breaker ka kaam karta hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ekdum sahi analogy! Ab Speaker ka tenure - normally Lok Sabha ke tenure ke barabar chalta hai. Unhe hataya jaata hai - Lok Sabha ke saare (total, sirf present-voting nahi) members ke majority se resolution pass karke, 14 din pehle notice dekar.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur agar Speaker resign karna chahe to kisko letter denge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Speaker apna resignation Deputy Speaker ko dete hain, aur Deputy Speaker apna resignation Speaker ko dete hain - dono ek doosre ko denge, President ko nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Interesting! Aur ek aur baat - naye Lok Sabha ka pehla session shuru hone pe, jab Speaker chuna hi nahi gaya, tab kaun manage karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut acha sawal! Tab President ek senior-most member ko 'Speaker Pro-tem' appoint karte hain, jo naye members ko oath dilate hain aur naye Speaker ka election karwate hain. Ab dhyan do Rajya Sabha pe - RS ka presiding officer 'Chairman' kehlata hai, aur ye koi member nahi banta, ye VICE PRESIDENT hote hain EX-OFFICIO (Article 89(1))!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Vice President seedhe Rajya Sabha ke Chairman ban jaate hain, bina election ke?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! Ye automatic hota hai unke Vice President bante hi. Lekin Rajya Sabha apna 'Deputy Chairman' khud apne members mein se chunti hai, jaise Lok Sabha Deputy Speaker chunti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, aur agar Vice President khud President ban jaayein ya President ka kaam sambhalein, tab Rajya Sabha kaun chalayega?

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Rajya Sabha ka Chairman kaun hota hai?

options.text: Rajya Sabha ka koi elected senior member

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 89(1) ke anusaar Vice President of India ex-officio Rajya Sabha ke Chairman hote hain - bina alag se election ke, unke Vice President bante hi ye pad mil jaata hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Article 100 ke anusaar, Lok Sabha Speaker kab vote karte hain?

options.text: Har bill par pehle vote karte hain
Sirf jab vote barabar (tie) ho jaaye, tab casting vote dete hain
Sirf Money Bill par vote karte hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Speaker normal voting mein participate nahi karte. Sirf tie hone ki sthiti mein, unka 'Casting Vote' faisla karta hai - ye Article 100 mein diya gaya hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: India ke pehle Lok Sabha Speaker kaun the?
quiz_payload.explanation: G.V. Mavalankar Bharat ke pehle Lok Sabha Speaker the (1952-1956).

milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Sadan ke bosses pehchan liye! Ab dekhte hain Sadan kab-kab baithti hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, Panchayat ki baithak roz thodi hoti hai - saal mein kuch fix baar hoti hai na?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan sir, Mukhiya bulate hain jab zaroorat hoti hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul waise hi Parliament ko bhi 'summon' kiya jaata hai - Article 85 ke tehat President Parliament ke har Sadan ko bulate hain. Rule ye hai: do sessions ke beech ka gap 6 mahine se zyada nahi hona chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab saal mein kam se kam do baar to session zaroor hogi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi socha - Constitution mein exact number nahi likha, bas 6-mahine ka gap-rule hai. Par practically, convention se, saal mein 3 sessions hoti hain: Budget Session (Feb-May, sabse lambi), Monsoon Session (July-Sept), aur Winter Session (Nov-Dec).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir 'Prorogation' aur 'Dissolution' mein kya farak hai? Dono same lagte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut common confusion! 'Prorogation' matlab session ka ANT hona - Sadan khud khatam nahi hoti, bas agla session tak break hoti hai. 'Dissolution' sirf Lok Sabha ke saath hota hai - poori Lok Sabha hi khatam ho jaati hai aur naye chunav ki zaroorat padti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Toh Rajya Sabha kabhi 'dissolve' nahi hoti kyunki wo Permanent House hai, sirf 'prorogue' hoti hai, sahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ab ek aur zaroori concept - Quorum. Matlab kam se kam kitne members present hone chahiye taaki Sadan mein kaam-kaaj chal sake.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Agar sab members nahi hai to bhi kaam ho jayega kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Article 100(3) ke anusaar quorum hai Sadan ki total sadasya sankhya ka 1/10th (das-vaan hissa). Agar poori Lok Sabha 543 hai, to sirf 55 members present hone se bhi kaam chal sakta hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to kaafi kam hai! Itne kam log kaise poore desh ke liye decide kar sakte hain?

guess_payload.question: Guess karo: Agar Sadan mein kaam-kaaj chalte waqt quorum poora na ho (kam log hon), to Presiding Officer kya karega?

options.text: Fir bhi kaam jaari rakhega, koi farak nahi padta
Sadan ko adjourn kar dega ya session suspend karega jab tak quorum poora na ho
Sabhi members ko turant bulwa lega

guess_payload.explanation: Agar Sadan mein quorum poora nahi hai, to Presiding Officer (Speaker/Chairman) proceedings ko suspend ya adjourn kar dete hain jab tak quorum poora na ho jaaye. Ye ek practical challenge hai kyunki bahut baar Sadan mein quorum ki kami dekhi jaati hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Article 85 ke anusaar, do Parliament sessions ke beech maximum gap kitna ho sakta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 85 kehta hai ki do sessions ke beech gap 6 mahine se zyada nahi ho sakta - isliye saal mein kam se kam 2 sessions to zaroor honi chahiye.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: 'Dissolution' aur 'Prorogation' mein sahi antar kya hai?

options.text: Prorogation sirf session ka ant hai; Dissolution sirf Lok Sabha ke saath hota hai aur poori Sabha khatam hoti hai
Dissolution Rajya Sabha ke saath hota hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Prorogation matlab ek session ka ant, Sadan khud nahi khatam hoti. Dissolution sirf Lok Sabha (kabhi Rajya Sabha nahi, kyunki wo Permanent House hai) ke saath hota hai aur naye chunav zaroori ho jaate hain.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Sadan mein kaam chalane ke liye quorum kitna hona chahiye?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 100(3) ke anusaar quorum, Sadan ki total sadasya sankhya ka 1/10th hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Sadan kab baithti hai, ab pata chal gaya! Ab dekhte hain Bill kaise kanoon banta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho ek naya rasta gaon mein banana hai - pehle proposal likha jaata hai, phir Panchayat mein charcha, phir final approval, tab kaam shuru hota hai. Kanoon banane mein bhi aise hi stages hoti hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to kanoon banane se pehle usko 'Bill' kehte hain na sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Bill teen 'readings' se guzarta hai. First Reading mein bill introduce hota hai. Second Reading mein detail discussion hoti hai, committee stage bhi ismein aata hai, clause-by-clause padha jaata hai. Third Reading mein final voting hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur ek Sadan se pass hone ke baad, doosre Sadan mein bhi yehi process dohrana padega?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi socha - Ordinary Bill kisi bhi Sadan mein pehle introduce ho sakta hai (Money Bill chhodkar), aur dono Sadan se pass hona zaroori hai. Uske baad President ke paas assent ke liye jaata hai - Article 111.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Agar Rajya Sabha bill ko reject kar de ya Lok Sabha se alag amendment kar de to phir kya hoga?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahi to interesting part hai! Jab dono Sadan mein deadlock ho jaaye, tab Article 108 ke tehat President 'Joint Sitting' bula sakte hain - dono Sadan ke members ek saath baithkar vote karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Joint sitting mein kaun preside karta hai? Speaker ya President khud?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: President khud preside nahi karte - Lok Sabha ke Speaker joint sitting preside karte hain (kyunki LS mein members zyada hote hain). Aur ye 3 conditions mein hoti hai: (1) ek Sadan reject kar de, (2) dono mein amendment pe assahmati ho, (3) 6 mahine tak koi action na ho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir kitni baar joint sitting hui hai ab tak India mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sirf 3 baar! 1961 mein Dowry Prohibition Bill, 1978 mein Banking Service Commission (Repeal) Bill, aur 2002 mein POTA (Prevention of Terrorism Act) Bill. ⭐ BPSC ka favorite trap: Joint Sitting Money Bill ya Constitutional Amendment Bill ke liye kabhi nahi ho sakti!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Matlab Money Bill mein Rajya Sabha ka koi deadlock hi nahi ban sakta joint sitting tak jaane ka!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda! Ab final step - President ke paas Bill jaane ke baad unke paas 3 options hote hain: (1) Assent de dein (bill Act ban jaata hai), (2) Withhold kar dein (mana kar dein), (3) Ordinary Bill ko ek baar reconsideration ke liye wapas bhej dein.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Agar wapas bheja hua bill dobara pass hokar aaye to?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tab President ko assent DENA hi padega, mana nahi kar sakte. Lekin yaad rakho - Money Bill ko President reconsideration ke liye wapas NAHI bhej sakte, sirf assent ya withhold kar sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye 'Money Bill' baar-baar special kyun treat ho raha hai sir? Agla topic yehi lagta hai!

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Article 108 ke tehat Joint Sitting kis Sadan ke Speaker/Chairman preside karte hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Joint Sitting mein Lok Sabha ke Speaker hi preside karte hain, kyunki Lok Sabha mein members zyada hote hain aur convention se yehi practice hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Ab tak Bharat mein kितनी बार Joint Sitting bulaayi gayi hai, aur konse bills ke liye?

options.text: 2 baar - Dowry Bill aur POTA Bill
3 baar - Dowry Prohibition Bill (1961), Banking Service Commission Repeal Bill (1978), POTA Bill (2002)

quiz_payload.explanation: Ab tak sirf 3 baar joint sitting hui hai: 1961 (Dowry Prohibition Bill), 1978 (Banking Service Commission Repeal Bill), 2002 (POTA Bill).

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Joint Sitting kis prakar ke Bill ke liye kabhi NAHI bulaayi ja sakti?

options.text: Money Bill aur Constitutional Amendment Bill

quiz_payload.explanation: Money Bill ke liye joint sitting ki zaroorat hi nahi padti (kyunki RS ke pass sirf recommend karne ki power hai), aur Constitutional Amendment Bill (Article 368) ke liye bhi joint sitting ka provision nahi hai - dono Sadan se alag-alag special majority se pass hona zaroori hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Kanoon banane ka process pakka hua! Ab Money Bill ka sabse bada trap todhte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ghar ka budget - kitna paisa aayega, kitna kharch hoga - iska faisla kaun karta hai, mummy ya papa?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ghar mein to mummy karti hain sir, unhi ko pata hota hai kitna kharcha hoga!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Waise hi desh ke paise (tax, kharcha, karza) se related bill ko 'Money Bill' kehte hain - Article 110 ismein define karta hai. Aur BPSC ka sabse bada trap: Money Bill SIRF Lok Sabha mein introduce ho sakta hai, Rajya Sabha mein kabhi nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh Rajya Sabha ka isme koi role hi nahi hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Rajya Sabha ka role hai - lekin bahut limited! Money Bill LS se pass hoke RS ke paas jaata hai, RS ke paas sirf 14 din hote hain use recommend karne ke liye. RS ise reject nahi kar sakti, sirf sujhaav de sakti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur Lok Sabha usko maanegi ya nahi, ye kaun decide karega?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye Lok Sabha ki marzi hai - wo RS ke suggestions maane ya na maane, dono option hai unke paas. Aur agar RS 14 din mein kuch na kare (na return kare, na recommend kare), to bill automatically dono Sadan se pass mana jaata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Money Bill mein Rajya Sabha ki power bahut kam hai! Aur ye decide kaun karta hai ki koi bill Money Bill hai ya nahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye faisla Lok Sabha ka SPEAKER karta hai, aur unka certificate FINAL hota hai - court mein challenge nahi ho sakta (Article 122 isko protect karta hai). Ab ek aur category suno - 'Financial Bill'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir Money Bill aur Financial Bill alag hote hain kya? Mujhe to same lag rahe hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahi sabse bada BPSC-level confusion hai! Financial Bill Category-A (Article 117(1)) mein money bill wale matters BHI hote hain PLUS kuch aur normal matters bhi. Isliye ise Money Bill nahi kaha jaata, lekin introduce sirf LS mein hoga, aur President ki prior recommendation chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur Category-B wala kya hai sir?

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Money Bill kis Sadan mein hi introduce ho sakta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 110 ke anusaar Money Bill SIRF Lok Sabha mein introduce ho sakta hai, aur wo bhi President ki prior recommendation ke saath. Isse Rajya Sabha ki taakat par control rehta hai financial matters mein.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Money Bill ke liye Rajya Sabha ke paas kitne din ka time hota hai apne sujhaav dene ke liye?
quiz_payload.explanation: Rajya Sabha ke paas Money Bill par recommendations dene ke liye sirf 14 din hote hain. Is dauran koi action na hone par bill automatically dono Sadan se pass maan liya jaata hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Koi Bill Money Bill hai ya nahi, iska final faisla kaun karta hai?

options.text: Lok Sabha Speaker (aur ye faisla court mein challenge nahi ho sakta)

quiz_payload.explanation: Lok Sabha ke Speaker ka certificate ye batata hai ki koi bill Money Bill hai ya nahi, aur Article 122 ke tehat ye faisla court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Money Bill ka trap solve ho gaya! Ab dekhte hain poore desh ka Budget kaise pass hota hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, saal ke shuru mein tumhare papa plan karte hain na - itna kamaenge, itna kharch karenge, itna bachaenge? Desh ka bhi ek aisa hi saalana plan hota hai, jise 'Budget' kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Isko official constitutional naam kya hai sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Article 112 mein ise 'Annual Financial Statement' kaha gaya hai. Finance Minister ise Lok Sabha mein pesh karte hain, usually February ko. ⭐ Yaad rakho: 2017 se pehle Railway Budget alag pesh hota tha, ab 2017 se General Budget mein hi merge kar diya gaya hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir Budget mein sirf 'kharcha' ka hisaab hota hai ya 'kamaai' ka bhi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Dono ka hisaab hota hai. Ab teen important 'Funds' samjho jo desh ke paise rakhte hain. Pehla: Consolidated Fund of India (Article 266) - iसमें sara tax revenue aur loan ka paisa aata hai, aur isse kharcha karne ke liye Parliament ki APPROVAL zaroori hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur baaki do funds sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Doosra: Contingency Fund of India (Article 267) - ye ek emergency piggy-bank hai, President ke control mein, achanak zaroorat padne par bina Parliament approval ke turant kharcha kar sakte hain, baad mein Parliament se approve karwaya jaata hai. Corpus abhi Rs 30,000 crore hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur teesra fund konsa hai sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Teesra hai Public Account of India (Article 266(2)) - ismein provident fund, small savings jaisi cheezein hoti hain jo sarkar 'trustee' ki tarah rakhti hai, isse nikaalne ke liye Parliament ki approval zaroori NAHI hoti.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Aur Consolidated Fund ka poora paisa Lok Sabha vote karke approve karti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahin ek zaroori twist hai! Kuch expenditure 'CHARGED' hoti hai - jaise President ki salary, Speaker/Deputy Speaker ki salary, judges ki salary, CAG ki salary - inpe Parliament sirf DISCUSS kar sakti hai, VOTE nahi kar sakti. Baaki sab 'VOTED' expenditure hoti hai jispe Lok Sabha vote karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh judges ki salary kum-zyada karne ka vote LS nahi kar sakti? Interesting!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi, isse judicial independence bachti hai. Ab 'Cut Motions' samjho - jab LS members Demand for Grant mein kharcha kam karna chahte hain, to 3 tarah ke cut motion move karte hain: Policy Cut (kisi policy ka virodh, amount ko Re 1 kar dena), Economy Cut (specific amount kam karna), aur Token Cut (Rs 100 katna, sirf disapproval jataane ke liye).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir sirf Lok Sabha hi vote karti hai Demand for Grant pe? Rajya Sabha kuch nahi karti?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Sirf Lok Sabha hi Demands for Grant pe vote karti hai - Rajya Sabha isme voting nahi kar sakti, bas discuss kar sakti hai. Iske baad Appropriation Bill (Article 114) pass hoti hai kharcha ki legal permission ke liye, aur Finance Bill (Article 110) taxation proposals ke liye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye Appropriation Bill aur Finance Bill dono alag hain? Ye to naya confusion aa gaya!

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Consolidated Fund of India se paisa nikalne ke liye kya zaroori hai?

options.text: Parliament ki approval (kanoon dwara authorize kiya jaana)

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 266 ke anusaar Consolidated Fund of India se koi bhi paisa Parliament ki approval (kanoon) ke bina nahi nikala ja sakta.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: 'Charged Expenditure' ke baare mein kaunsa kathan sahi hai?

options.text: Lok Sabha isko vote karke pass karti hai
Lok Sabha sirf discuss kar sakti hai, vote nahi kar sakti (jaise President/Judges ki salary)
Rajya Sabha isko approve karti hai
Isko Finance Minister decide karte hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Charged expenditure (President, Speaker, Judges ki salary, debt charges etc.) par Parliament VOTE nahi kar sakti, sirf discuss kar sakti hai - taaki judicial/constitutional independence bani rahe.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Cut Motion ka 'Token Cut' kis amount ko kata jaata hai?

options.text: Poori Demand ko Re 1 kar diya jaata hai
Rs 100 kata jaata hai, disapproval jataane ke liye
Ek specific amount kam kiya jaata hai
Demand poori tarah reject kar di jaati hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Token Cut Motion mein Demand ki amount se Rs 100 kata jaata hai, iska matlab hai member sarkar ki policy se disagree karta hai lekin poori tarah reject nahi karna chahta.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Budget master ban gaye! Ab Parliament ke chhote-chhote 'watchdog' groups - Committees - jaante hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, poori Parliament ke 543+245 members ek saath baithkar har chhoti detail check nahi kar sakte na? Isliye chhoti-chhoti teams banayi jaati hain jo detail mein kaam check karti hain - inhe 'Parliamentary Committees' kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Jaise class mein group project ke liye chhote-chhote group banate hain, waise hi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi analogy! Sabse important hai Public Accounts Committee (PAC) - 22 members (15 Lok Sabha + 7 Rajya Sabha), jo CAG ki report ki jaanch karti hai ki sarkar ne paisa sahi kharcha kiya ya nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Iska Chairman kaun banta hai sir, ruling party ka?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahi bada interesting fact hai - 1967 se ek convention chal rahi hai ki PAC ka Chairman VIRODHI DAL (opposition) se hota hai! Isse transparency maintain hoti hai ki ruling party khud apni jaanch na kare.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Toh sarkar khud apna hisaab-kitaab check nahi karti, opposition karti hai - fair hai ye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! Ab Estimates Committee samjho - ye sirf Lok Sabha ke members se banti hai, 30 members, aur ise 'Continuing Economy Committee' bhi kehte hain kyunki ye budget estimates mein bachat (economy) ke suggestions deti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir PAC mein RS ke members hain lekin Estimates Committee mein sirf LS? Ye alag kyun hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye historically decide kiya gaya - Estimates Committee ka focus sirf financial estimates hai jo primarily LS ka domain hai. Ab teesri financial committee - Committee on Public Undertakings (COPU) - 22 members (15 LS + 7 RS), jo PSUs (Public Sector Undertakings) ka kaam-kaaj check karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye teeno - PAC, Estimates, COPU - inhe 'Financial Committees' kehte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Aur ek aur important type hai - Departmental Related Standing Committees (DRSCs), 1993 mein shuru hui thin, jo har ministry ke bills aur kaam-kaaj ko detail mein scrutinize karti hain. Abhi total 24 DRSCs hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Ye committees to poore government ka postmortem karti rehti hain, sahi mein 'watchdogs' hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi bola! Ab dhyan do - committees do type ki hoti hain: 'Standing Committees' (permanent, jaise PAC, Estimates, COPU, DRSCs) aur 'Ad hoc Committees' (temporary, khaas kaam ke liye banti hain jaise 'Select Committee' ya 'Joint Committee on a Bill', kaam poora hote hi khatam ho jaati hain).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh PAC hamesha rahegi, par kisi ek bill ke liye banayi gayi committee kaam khatam hote hi khatam ho jayegi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi samjhe! Ye difference exam mein directly poocha jaata hai - Standing vs Ad hoc.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya sir, ab quiz de dijiye!

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Public Accounts Committee (PAC) ka Chairman convention ke anusaar kis se hota hai?

options.text: Ruling party ka koi senior member

quiz_payload.explanation: 1967 se ek convention chal rahi hai ki PAC ka Chairman opposition party se hota hai, taaki financial accountability check karne mein transparency bani rahe.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Estimates Committee ke baare mein kaunsa kathan sahi hai?

options.text: Isme Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha dono ke members hote hain
Isme sirf Lok Sabha ke 30 members hote hain
Ye PSU ka kaam-kaaj check karti hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Estimates Committee mein sirf Lok Sabha ke 30 members hote hain, isliye Rajya Sabha ka isme koi representation nahi hai. Ise 'Continuing Economy Committee' kehte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: 'Ad hoc Committee' aur 'Standing Committee' mein main antar kya hai?

options.text: Ad hoc Committee permanent hoti hai, Standing temporary
Standing Committee permanent hoti hai; Ad hoc Committee kisi khaas kaam ke liye banti hai aur kaam khatam hote hi khatam ho jaati hai
Ad hoc Committee sirf Rajya Sabha mein hoti hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Standing Committees permanent hoti hain aur regularly kaam karti hain (jaise PAC), jabki Ad hoc Committees kisi specific purpose (jaise ek bill par Select/Joint Committee) ke liye banti hain aur kaam poora hote hi bhang ho jaati hain.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Watchdog committees pakki hui! Ab dekhte hain Parliament ke saare BADE POWERS ek saath.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab tak humne Parliament ke parts dekhe, ab uske saare KAAM ek saath samjhte hain. Sabse pehla hai - Legislative Power - Parliament Union List aur Concurrent List ke subjects par kanoon bana sakti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir agar koi cheez State List mein ho, to kya Parliament kabhi usme kanoon nahi bana sakti?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Achha sawal! Normally nahi, LEKIN 4 special situations mein bana sakti hai: Article 249 (agar Rajya Sabha 2/3rd majority se resolution paas kare national interest mein), Article 250 (National Emergency ke dauran), Article 252 (agar do ya zyada states khud request karein), Article 253 (international treaty implement karne ke liye).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Matlab Rajya Sabha ke paas ek special power hai State List pe bhi kanoon banwane ka, ye interesting hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi, aage aayega us pe. Ab doosra power - Executive Control. Article 75(3) kehta hai Council of Ministers LOK SABHA ke prati SAMUHIK RUP SE (collectively) uttardai (responsible) hai - matlab sarkar ko LS ka vishwas chahiye rehne ke liye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isliye No-Confidence Motion se sarkar gir jaati hai na sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Teesra power hai Financial - Budget ko approve karna, tax lagana. Chautha hai Constituent Power - Article 368 ke tehat Constitution mein amendment karna. Paanchwa Judicial - President ka impeachment (Article 61), judges ko hataana (Article 124(4)).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir itne saare powers! Ek aur bhi bacha hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, ek aur - Electoral Power. Parliament ke elected members, State Vidhan Sabha ke saath milkar President ka chunav karte hain, aur akele hi Vice President ka chunav karte hain. Isके alawa Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Chairman, Deputy Chairman jaise apne internal officers bhi elect karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir Vice President ka election mein State Assembly involve nahi hoti?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda! Vice President sirf Parliament ke members (LS+RS dono, elected aur nominated dono) chunte hain - iska Electoral College State Assembly ko include NAHI karta, jabki President ke Electoral College mein State Assembly bhi shaamil hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye to bada important difference hai President vs Vice President election mein!

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: Kis Article ke tehat Rajya Sabha 2/3rd majority se resolution paas karke Parliament ko State List par kanoon banane ka adhikar de sakti hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 249 ke tehat Rajya Sabha, present-voting members ke 2/3rd majority se, ye resolution paas kar sakti hai ki national interest mein Parliament State List ke kisi subject par kanoon banaye - ye 1 saal ke liye valid hota hai, renewable.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Council of Ministers, kis Sadan ke prati samuhik roop se uttardai hoti hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 75(3) ke anusaar Council of Ministers sirf LOK SABHA ke prati samuhik roop se uttardai hoti hai - isi wajah se No-Confidence Motion sirf Lok Sabha mein laayi jaa sakti hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: Vice President ka chunav kaun karta hai?

options.text: Parliament ke dono Sadan ke elected + nominated members (State Assembly involved nahi)
State Assembly ke members bhi shaamil hote hain jaise President election mein
Sirf Prime Minister nominate karte hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Vice President ka Electoral College sirf Parliament ke dono Sadan ke members (elected + nominated) se banta hai. State Legislative Assembly members isme shaamil nahi hote - ye President ke election se alag hai jisme states bhi involve hoti hain.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Saare powers pakke hue! Ab MP ki special 'Special Powers' - Privileges dekhte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, socho Sadan mein ek MP sarkar ki galti pe bahut tez bol raha hai - agar bahar hota to shayad case ho jaata defamation ka. Par Sadan ke andar unhe kuch special suraksha (protection) milti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab MP jo bhi bole, uspe koi case nahi ho sakta?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi disha mein soch rahe ho! Article 105 kehta hai MP ko Parliament ke andar 'Freedom of Speech' hai, aur unke kisi bhi bhashan ya vote ke liye kisi court mein unke against koi proceeding nahi chal sakti - Article 105(2).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Matlab MP Sadan ke andar kuch bhi bol sakta hai, kisi ki bhi burai kar sakta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ruko! Ye freedom bhi absolute nahi hai - Rules of Procedure aur Speaker ke control ke andar hoti hai. Ye sirf Sadan ke ANDAR bole gaye baaton ke liye hai, agar wahi baat MP Sadan ke bahar interview mein bole, to normal defamation kanoon lagu hote hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Toh Sadan ke andar aur bahar alag rule hai. Aur ek baat sir, MP ko arrest nahi kar sakte kya, koi bhi time pe?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut acha sawal - ek aur privilege hai 'Freedom from Arrest' - lekin ye sirf CIVIL cases mein hai, criminal cases mein NAHI. MP ko session ke dauran, aur session shuru hone se 40 din pehle aur khatam hone ke 40 din baad tak civil case mein arrest nahi kiya ja sakta.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab agar koi MP ne murder kiya ho to ye privilege nahi bachayegi use?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Criminal cases mein koi arrest-se-suraksha nahi hai, MP ko normal citizen ki tarah criminal law follow karna padta hai. Kuch aur privileges hain - Sadan ki proceedings ko publish karne ka adhikar, Sadan mein bahar ke logon (strangers) ko exclude karne ka adhikar, aur 'contempt' ya 'breach of privilege' karne walon ko punish karne ka adhikar.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye privileges kahan likhi hain Constitution mein, poori list?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Interesting baat ye hai ki Constitution mein privileges ki poori codified list nahi hai - Article 105 basic wale batata hai, baaki House of Commons (Britain) ki parampara aur Parliament ke apne banaye kanoon se follow hoti hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Matlab ye ek 'living tradition' hai, poori tarah likhi hui nahi hai!

options.text: Civil cases mein hi, criminal cases mein nahi

quiz_payload.explanation: MP ko session ke dauran aur session shuru/khatam hone se 40 din pehle/baad, sirf CIVIL cases mein arrest se suraksha milti hai. Criminal cases mein ye privilege lagu nahi hoti.

quiz_payload.explanation: Constitution mein privileges ki poori codified list nahi hai. Article 105 basic privileges deta hai, aur baaki House of Commons (UK) ki parampara tatha Parliament ke banaye kanoon se follow hoti hain.

milestone_payload.motivational_quote: MP ki suraksha samajh gaye! Ab Sadan ke rojana ke drama - Question Hour aur Zero Hour dekhte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, Sadan ka din kaise shuru hota hai pata hai? Har din ka pehla ghanta 'Question Hour' hota hai - jisme MPs Ministers se sawaal poochte hain sarkar ke kaam-kaaj par.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir kaisa sawaal? Koi bhi poonch sakta hai kuch bhi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Do type ke questions hote hain - 'Starred Question' (jispe zubaani jawab milta hai, aur supplementary question bhi pooch sakte hain) aur 'Unstarred Question' (jispe sirf likhit/written jawab milta hai, supplementary nahi poochh sakte).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Aur agar koi urgent matter ho jo Question Hour mein na aa paye to?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Isi ke liye hai 'Zero Hour'! Ye Question Hour ke turant baad, dopahar 12 baje shuru hota hai. Aur ⭐ BPSC ka bahut favorite trap: Zero Hour Rules of Procedure mein LIKHA hua nahi hai - ye ek Indian innovation hai jo practice se vikasit hui!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab kahin bhi Constitution ya rule book mein 'Zero Hour' shabd nahi likha hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Isme members bina prior notice ke urgent public importance ke matters uthate hain. Isliye ise Indian Parliament ki apni khoj (contribution) mana jaata hai, ye kahin aur world mein aisa nahi hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wah, ye to India ne khud invent kiya! Ab motions ke baare mein bataiye sir.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab do important motions samjho jo bahut confuse karti hain - 'No-Confidence Motion' aur 'Censure Motion'. No-Confidence sirf LOK SABHA mein laayi ja sakti hai (kyunki sarkar sirf LS ke prati uttardai hai), aur admit hone ke liye 50 members ka support chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur agar No-Confidence pass ho jaaye to sarkar gir jaati hai na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Poori Council of Ministers ko resign karna padta hai. Ab Censure Motion - ye poori Council of Ministers ya kisi ek individual Minister ke against bhi laayi ja sakti hai, ISME reasons batana ZAROORI hai (No-Confidence mein reasons batana zaroori nahi).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur agar Censure Motion pass ho jaaye to bhi sarkar girni padegi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju! Yahi bada trap hai - Censure Motion pass hone par sarkar ko resign karna ZAROORI NAHI hai. Sirf No-Confidence Motion pass hone par hi resign karna padta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab Censure sirf ninda (disapproval) jataane ke liye hai, girane ke liye nahi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ab do aur devices - Adjournment Motion (urgent public importance matter, sarkar ki ninda involve hoti hai, ye bhi sirf LS mein, 50 members ka support chahiye, aur Sadan ka normal kaam-kaaj rok deta hai) aur Calling Attention Motion (ek Indian innovation, member Minister ka dhyan kisi urgent matter ki taraf khinchta hai, koi voting nahi hoti).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir itne saare motions! Inko kaise yaad rakhun exam ke liye?

quiz_payload.question: Q1/3: 'Zero Hour' ke baare mein sahi kathan chuno.

options.text: Ye Constitution mein Article 118 ke tehat likha hai
Ye Rules of Procedure mein likhit nahi hai, ek Indian innovation hai, jo Question Hour ke turant baad shuru hoti hai
Ye sirf Rajya Sabha mein hoti hai
Iske liye pehle se notice dena zaroori hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Zero Hour Rules of Procedure mein formally likhit nahi hai - ye ek Indian Parliament ki practical innovation hai, jo Question Hour khatam hone ke baad, dopahar 12 baje shuru hoti hai, bina prior notice ke urgent matters uthane ke liye.

quiz_payload.question: Q2/3: Censure Motion aur No-Confidence Motion mein kya antar hai?

options.text: Censure Motion mein reasons dena zaroori hai aur pass hone par sarkar ka resign karna zaroori nahi; No-Confidence Motion pass hone par sarkar ko resign karna hi padta hai
No-Confidence Motion Rajya Sabha mein laayi jaati hai
Censure Motion sirf President ke against laayi jaati hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Censure Motion mein reasons batana zaroori hai, aur ye kisi individual minister ke against bhi ho sakti hai; iske pass hone par sarkar ka resign karna zaroori nahi. No-Confidence Motion sirf poori Council of Ministers ke against hoti hai aur pass hone par government girni padti hai.

quiz_payload.question: Q3/3: No-Confidence Motion aur Adjournment Motion ko admit hone ke liye kitne members ka samarthan chahiye?
quiz_payload.explanation: No-Confidence Motion aur Adjournment Motion, dono ko admit hone ke liye 50 members ka samarthan chahiye hota hai, aur dono sirf Lok Sabha mein laayi ja sakti hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ek dilchasp baat - hum sochte hain Rajya Sabha to Lok Sabha se kam powerful hai, financial matters mein to bilkul limited hai. Lekin do khaas Articles mein Rajya Sabha ke paas EXTRA power hoti hai jo Lok Sabha ke paas bhi nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Rajya Sabha ke paas extra power? Konsi sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Article 249 - jo humne pehle padha, sirf Rajya Sabha State List pe kanoon banwa sakti hai 2/3rd majority se. Aur Article 312 - Rajya Sabha, 2/3rd majority se resolution paas karke, ek NAYI All India Service bana sakti hai (jaise IAS, IPS, IFS jaisi)!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wah! Matlab agar sarkar chaahe naya 'All India Forest Service' jaisa kuch banana, to pehle Rajya Sabha se resolution chahiye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ye Article 312 hi tha jisse IAS/IPS jaisi services banayi gayi thin. Ab President ke Parliament se related role revise karte hain: President Sadan ko summon karte hain, prorogue karte hain, Lok Sabha bhang karte hain (Article 85), aur SAAL KE PEHLE SESSION mein dono Sadan ko sambodhit (address) karte hain - Article 87.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wahi speech jisme President parliament ko batate hain sarkar kya karegi is saal?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Aur agar Parliament session mein nahi hai aur turant kanoon ki zaroorat pad jaaye, to President Article 123 ke tehat 'Ordinance' jaari kar sakte hain - iski power kanoon jaisi hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ordinance hamesha ke liye chalta rahega ya expire bhi hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut acha sawal! Ordinance hamesha ke liye nahi chalta - Parliament ka session dobara shuru hone ke 6 hafte (6 weeks) ke andar use dono Sadan se approve karwana zaroori hai, warna ye AUTOMATICALLY lapse ho jaata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Matlab Ordinance sirf ek temporary jugaad hai jab tak Parliament khud kanoon nahi bana leti!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi samjhe! Yehi Parliament aur President ka poora rishta hai - dono ek doosre ke bina adhoore hain. Chalo ab last quiz set karte hain is module ka!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ready sir! Poori Parliament ki poori kahani samajh mein aa gayi!

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 123 ke anusaar, Ordinance Parliament ke dobara session shuru hone ke 6 hafte ke andar approve hona zaroori hai, warna ye automatically lapse ho jaata hai.

revision_points.point: Consider these statements: (1) Original max strength was 552 including 2 Anglo-Indian nominated seats. (2) 104th Amendment, 2019 abolished Anglo-Indian nomination, making theoretical max 550. (3) Current actual strength is 543, frozen on 1971 census till 2026 (84th Amendment). All three statements are CORRECT - a classic BPSC multi-statement trap.

Rajya Sabha: max 250 (238 elected + 12 nominated), Permanent House, 1/3rd retire every 2 years, tenure 6 years, indirect election via State MLAs (PR-STV). Lok Sabha: max 550 now, direct election, tenure 5 years, can be dissolved. Bihar sends 40 to Lok Sabha and 16 to Rajya Sabha.

Money Bill (Article 110) can be introduced ONLY in Lok Sabha with President's prior recommendation; Rajya Sabha can only delay it for 14 days and recommend changes (LS can reject); Speaker's certification that a bill is a Money Bill is final and cannot be challenged in any court (Article 122).

10th Schedule added by 52nd Amendment (1985); 91st Amendment (2003) removed the 'Split' exception (1/3rd group), only 'Merger' (2/3rd members) remains valid; Speaker/Chairman decides, but Kihoto Hollohan case (1992) made this decision subject to judicial review.

No-Confidence Motion: only in Lok Sabha, needs 50 members support, no reasons required, government MUST resign if passed. Censure Motion: can target individual minister too, reasons compulsory, government need NOT resign if passed. Joint Sitting (Article 108): presided by Lok Sabha Speaker, held only 3 times ever, never possible for Money Bills or Constitutional Amendment Bills.

Assertion (A): Rajya Sabha ka Money Bill par koi vastvik (real) niyantran (control) nahi hota.
Reason (R): Money Bill sirf Lok Sabha mein President ki poorva sifarish (prior recommendation) se introduce ho sakta hai, aur Rajya Sabha isse sirf 14 din tak rok sakti hai aur sujhaav de sakti hai, jinhe Lok Sabha maanna zaroori nahi.

quiz_payload.explanation: Dono statements sahi hain aur R sahi tarah A ki vyakhya karta hai. Article 110 aur 109 ke pravdhaan ke anusaar Money Bill ka poora niyantran Lok Sabha ke paas hai, Rajya Sabha ki bhoomika sirf salahkari (advisory) aur waqt-simit (time-bound, 14 din) hai. Ye is topic ka sabse zyada poocha jaane wala BPSC/UPSC-level Assertion-Reason trap hai.
